g.text: Native int4 on Jetson Thor: measured results
SSD-backed Colibri · 4 HTTP requests per configuration · one server start each
TTFT proxy = first nonempty streamed output; exact first-token timing and steady decode speed were not recorded.
Default CUDA produced invalid output and is excluded. Small, ordered study; requests are correlated within each server start.
